name: Mace of Terror

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Terror
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: creatures of your choice within 30 ft make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute, fleeing you.

summary: 3 charges: a wave of terror makes creatures within 30 ft save (Wis DC 15) or flee in fear for 1 minute.
text: This magic weapon has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can take a Magic action and expend 1 charge to release a wave of terror from it. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While Frightened in this way, a creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't take Reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If it has nowhere it can move, the creature can take the Dodge action. At the end of each of its turns, a creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
